description: Sent at the end of a Duck.ai session on iOS: one visit to a full Duck.ai tab, from the tab becoming visible until Duck.ai is left (another tab is selected or the tab navigates to a non-Duck.ai page), the app is backgrounded, or the process ends. Opening or dismissing the tab switcher does not end the session. Contextual chat and the Duck.ai address bar input shown before a full tab opens are out of scope.

form_factor.description: The form factor of the device

platform.description: The platform the app is running on

is_first_daily_occurrence.description: Whether this is the first occurrence of this event today. Only included when true.

name.description: The feature name for this event

status.description: The overall status of the operation

status_reason.description: How the session ended. left_duckai (SUCCESS): Duck.ai is no longer the visible tab or the tab navigated to a non-Duck.ai page. app_backgrounded (CANCELLED): the app moved to the background while Duck.ai was visible. app_terminated (UNKNOWN): the process ended before another outcome was recorded; completed at the next launch.

exit_trigger.description: The action that caused the transition away from Duck.ai. Present only when status_reason is left_duckai. back_or_close: Back or a close of the Duck.ai tab. tab_switched: the user selected another existing tab. new_tab_opened: the user opened a new tab. fire_tab_opened: the user opened a Fire tab. search_started: the user started a Search from Duck.ai. other_navigation: no mapped action explains the transition.

step.description: Session activity. A present value of true means the action happened at least once during the session; an absent field means it did not happen.

prompt_submitted.description: A prompt was submitted in the visible Duck.ai tab.

new_chat_created.description: A new chat was created from the active Duck.ai session (frontend New Chat, the Duck.ai header's New Chat or New Image, or Recent chats' New Chat).

chat_id_changed.description: The visible tab's Duck.ai URL changed from one chatID value to another, including a change between missing and present. The identifier itself is never sent.
